guitar.notes: Hozier is commonly seen with Gibson acoustic guitars (e.g. J-45-style) live, and Telecasters for electric parts; reasonably documented but not singularly iconic.

tone.target: dark, roomy indie-folk crunch with pulse-like drive
tone.profile: dark, roomy indie-folk crunch with pulse-like drive
tone.summary: A dark, compressed signal chain using a midgain British amp model (UK 45) combined with subtle compression and room reverb to achieve the required indie-folk crunch.
corrections: favor darker drive over clean breakup

rig.name: Hozier - Eat Your Young - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and maintain signal tightness.

blocks.gap: The RAT is often aggressive; settings are dialed back to favor mid-range crunch over grit.

alternatives.reason: A slightly cleaner, more vintage overdrive option.

blocks.purpose: Simulate a midgain British amp for the required dark, punchy tone.
